voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In July twenty fourteen, a twenty-eight-year-old German named Lars Mittank went to Varna Airport, in Bulgaria, to fly home.
Days earlier, his ear had been hurt in a fight. At the airport, he saw a doctor. Then he ran out of the building, leaving his bags, his phone and his passport behind.
Security cameras show him climbing a fence, crossing a meadow, and running toward the woods.
